topic.title: Rock Paper Scissors
topic.description: A text-based Rock Paper Scissors game against the computer with ASCII art displays. Consolidates conditionals, random choice, and user input handling.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Using random.randint to simulate computer choice, handling all win/draw/lose conditions, and validating user input.
learningNotes.challenges: Covering all 9 possible outcome combinations without missing a case.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add a score tracker and best-of-five mode.

files.description: Rock Paper Scissors with ASCII art for each move.
